clips.title: The story
paras: Astranaar holds the Night Elves’ ground in central Ashenvale, across an island in the forest lake. The ancient forest road runs beside it, and Alliance travelers find refuge there as furbolgs, satyrs, and the Horde threaten the region.

Wooden footbridges link Astranaar’s island to the mainland, crossing the forest lake. It is Ashenvale’s largest night elven settlement, where sentinels, priests, and artisans keep watch over the woodlands. Travelers find an inn, traders, and an expert leatherworker. On the high perches, a flight master sends hippogryphs to distant outposts across Kalimdor.

Lanterns glow over Astranaar’s tranquil waters, but the town stays ready for attack. Raene Wolfrunner and other local leaders coordinate patrols and defenses against the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs advancing from the north. The Sentinels fear the furbolgs may assault the settlement.
